question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
WITH input_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, MAX(stamp) as input_stamp
  FROM form_log
  WHERE path = '/regist/input'
  GROUP BY session
),
confirm_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as confirm_stamp
  FROM form_log
  WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
  GROUP BY session
)
SELECT i.session, i.input_stamp, c.confirm_stamp,
       (i.input_stamp < c.confirm_stamp) as in_order
FROM input_sessions i
JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
ORDER BY i.session
